_about: Literature ledger (docs/research/publication.md, rule 3). Every number the summary quotes from a paper comes from here. version_read: version of record (VoR), accepted manuscript (AM) or preprint. checked_vor: whether the value was compared with the version of record. Before any submission every entry must have checked_vor = true.

landesfeind2019_tplus_eq20_ec_emc.quantity: fit parameters p1..p9 of the transference number, Eq. 20, LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 w:w); c in mol/L, T in K
landesfeind2019_tplus_eq20_ec_emc.do_not_evaluate: The printed parameters have three significant digits and the polynomial cancels terms of size ~24 at 20 C (p3*T, p6*T^2), so rounding alone moves t+ by about +-0.4. Evaluated at 1 M, 293.15 K it gives 0.16, not the 0.22 the text reports. Quote the text values (landesfeind2019_tplus_1M_20C_ec_emc) instead.

dougassa2014_table2_emc_vapour_pressure.quantity: vapour pressure of pure EMC measured by the isochoric saturation technique, 13 points; the table columns are printed as 10*p/kPa
dougassa2014_table2_emc_vapour_pressure.source: Y. R. Dougassa, J. Jacquemin, L. El Ouatani, C. Tessier, M. Anouti, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 79, 49 (2014)
dougassa2014_table2_emc_vapour_pressure.location: Table 2 (p. 54, EMC block, columns 'exptl' and 'calcd' of 10 p_sat); Table 3 (p. 55, Antoine coefficients, equation (13) ln(p/kPa) = A - B/(T/K + C)); Table 1 (p. 51): EMC Aldrich, mole fraction 0.9999, water < 10e-6; uncertainties u(T) = 0.1 K, u(p) = 0.05 p + 0.1 kPa (footnote b of Table 2)
dougassa2014_table2_emc_vapour_pressure.note: The paper is about methane solubility; the vapour pressures are a by-product. The Antoine constants (calcd column) are from Zhang et al. 2010 (ref. 57, entry zhang2010_table1_emc_boiling_point), not fitted to these data; they are the same numbers as Zhang's log10 constants times ln 10. Derived by us with tools/thermo/goldberg_dh.py (not printed): a straight-line fit of ln p against 1/T over the 13 measured points gives Delta_vap H = 40.69 +/- 0.57 kJ/mol (mean over 277.96 to 333.15 K, 1 SE of the slope) and p(298.15 K) = 3.40 kPa; the measured point at 298.15 K is 3.658 kPa. Goldberg's Antoine gives 40.35 kJ/mol and 3.437 kPa. No enthalpy of vaporization of EMC is printed in the paper. Second reading 2026-11-28: all values agree.

ravikumar2018_box_size_d.location: SI Fig. S2 caption; main text p. 8175 ('vary only by 2 %')
ravikumar2018_box_size_d.version_read: VoR main text and SI (PDFs in ../Lit), 2026-11-28
ravikumar2018_box_size_d.note: Model numbers, quoted for finite-size practice only. Doubling the volume changes L by 1.26, so Yeh-Hummer predicts only a 21 % change of the correction itself; no error bars are given, so the test cannot exclude the correction.

su2019_table_s7_dosy_ec_emc.quantity: 1H/7Li DOSY self-diffusion (1e-10 m2/s) in EC:EMC 1:1 (molar) and in LiPF6:EC:EMC 1:4:4 (molar), both with toluene added as internal reference; temperature not stated
su2019_table_s7_dosy_ec_emc.source: C.-C. Su, M. He, R. Amine, T. Rojas, L. Cheng, A. T. Ngo, K. Amine, Energy Environ. Sci. 12, 1249 (2019), ESI
su2019_table_s7_dosy_ec_emc.location: ESI Table S7 (p. 19); DOSY method p. 4 of the ESI
su2019_table_s7_dosy_ec_emc.version_read: VoR main text and ESI (PDFs in ../Lit), 2026-11-28
su2019_table_s7_dosy_ec_emc.note: Not a target: toluene in the sample, EC-richer solvent, about 1.4 M (our estimate), T unknown. Only an order-of-magnitude check that Li+ diffuses at about 0.55-0.7 of the solvent.

hou2021_quoted_solvent_viscosities.quantity: pure-solvent viscosities quoted (not measured) by Hou et al.: FEC at 298 K, EC at 313 K, EMC at 298 K, cP
hou2021_quoted_solvent_viscosities.source: T. Hou, K. D. Fong, J. Wang, K. A. Persson, Chem. Sci. 12, 14740 (2021), citing their refs. 73 (Xia et al., ChemistrySelect 2, 7353 (2017)) and 74 (Hagiyama et al., Chem. Lett. 37, 210 (2008))
hou2021_quoted_solvent_viscosities.note: Secondary quotations; the primary measurements were not read. Which of refs. 73-74 gives which value is not stated.

morita1998_table2_raman_solvation.quantity: apparent Li+ solvation numbers N_s from Raman side bands (EC ring deformation at 900 cm-1, DMC at 920 cm-1), LiPF6 in EC:DMC 50:50 by volume, room temperature; no correction for the change of Raman activity on binding
morita1998_table2_raman_solvation.source: M. Morita, Y. Asai, N. Yoshimoto, M. Ishikawa, J. Chem. Soc., Faraday Trans. 94, 3451 (1998)
morita1998_table2_raman_solvation.doi: not printed in the PDF; not looked up
morita1998_table2_raman_solvation.note: Borodin & Smith 2009 reanalyse such Raman data with computed Raman activities and find much less EC preference; Uchida 2021 applies that correction (uchida2021_table_s7_raman_solvation). Use Morita only together with that caveat.

uchida2021_table_s7_raman_solvation.quantity: average Li+ solvation numbers from Raman with the Raman-activity correction of Borodin et al., 1.0 mol/kg LiPF6 in EC:DMC at x_EC (mole fraction of EC in the solvent), room temperature
uchida2021_table_s7_raman_solvation.source: S. Uchida, T. Kiyobayashi, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 23, 10875 (2021), ESI
uchida2021_table_s7_raman_solvation.location: ESI Table S VII (p. 4); method Section 2.3 of the main text
uchida2021_table_s7_raman_solvation.version_read: VoR main text and ESI (PDFs in ../Lit), 2026-11-28
uchida2021_table_s7_raman_solvation.note: EC:DMC, not EC:EMC. A structural cross-check of the EC share of the Li+ shell next to the DRS estimate (self2024_drs_free_ec).

goldberg2026_table3_emc_vapour_pressure.quantity: vapour pressure of pure EMC, measured with a dynamic recirculating still (16 points); EMC purity 98.30 % (GC, Carl Roth, Table 2)
goldberg2026_table3_emc_vapour_pressure.source: T. Goldberg, V. Herdegen, A. S. Braeuer, J. Chem. Eng. Data 71, 4756 (2026), CC BY; raw data doi 10.25532/OPARA-1547
goldberg2026_table3_emc_vapour_pressure.location: Table 3 (p. 4761, EMC columns); chemicals Table 2 (p. 4757); standard uncertainties u_p = 0.35 kPa and u_T = 0.06 K under Table 3
goldberg2026_table3_emc_vapour_pressure.note: The authors state that the residuals against the Antoine fit scatter about one order of magnitude more than the GUM-based pressure uncertainty, so u_p = 0.35 kPa is a lower bound. Second reading 2026-11-28 by an independent pass over the extracted text: numbers and pages agree.

goldberg2026_table4_antoine_emc.quantity: Antoine parameters of EMC, log10(p) = A - B/(T + C), p in Pa, T in K, fitted to the authors' points together with literature points screened with Cook's distance (D > 4/N); data points accepted/excluded 24/4; fitted range 292.7 to 380.6 K and 2.52 to 101.3 kPa; AARD in p 1.04 %
goldberg2026_table4_antoine_emc.source: T. Goldberg, V. Herdegen, A. S. Braeuer, J. Chem. Eng. Data 71, 4756 (2026), CC BY
goldberg2026_table4_antoine_emc.location: Table 4 (p. 4762); screening procedure in 'Vapor Pressure Correlation' (p. 4758); no enthalpy of vaporization is printed in the paper
goldberg2026_table4_antoine_emc.note: Derived by us from these three numbers (not printed): p(298.15 K) = 3.437 kPa, and from d ln p/dT with the ideal-gas Clausius-Clapeyron relation, Delta_vap H(298.15 K) = R ln10 B T^2/(T+C)^2 = 40.35 kJ/mol, T_b(101.325 kPa) = 381.03 K (measured 380.61 K at 101.29 kPa). 298.15 K lies inside the fitted range (292.7 to 380.6 K) but only 5.5 K above its lowest point (the lowest measured EMC point is 2.52 kPa at 292.66 K). The script is tools/thermo/goldberg_dh.py. The authors use the same relation (Eq. 13) for the interaction energy in their UNIQUAC model. Second reading 2026-11-28 by an independent pass over the extracted text: numbers and pages agree.

goldberg2026_table4_antoine_dmc.quantity: Antoine parameters of DMC, log10(p) = A - B/(T + C), p in Pa, T in K, same fit as the EMC entry; data points accepted/excluded 154/29; fitted range 285.8 to 428.2 K and 3.85 to 566.5 kPa; AARD in p 0.41 %
goldberg2026_table4_antoine_dmc.source: T. Goldberg, V. Herdegen, A. S. Braeuer, J. Chem. Eng. Data 71, 4756 (2026), CC BY
goldberg2026_table4_antoine_dmc.note: Held-out reference for SC-7 (same factors applied to DMC). Derived by us with tools/thermo/goldberg_dh.py (not printed in the paper): p(298.15 K) = 7.378 kPa, Delta_vap H(298.15 K) = 37.38 kJ/mol, i.e. 0.64 kJ/mol below Kozlova 2008 (38.02 +/- 0.19, entry kozlova2008_table1_dmc_dhvap). Second reading 2026-11-28 by an independent pass over the extracted text: numbers and pages agree.

oh2018_table1_emc_density_nd.quantity: density and refractive index n_D of pure EMC at 298.15 K and 101.3 kPa
oh2018_table1_emc_density_nd.source: H. Y. Oh, J.-E. Gu, S.-J. Park, Fluid Phase Equilib. 473, 138 (2018)
oh2018_table1_emc_density_nd.location: Table 1 (p. 139), EMC row, 'Exp.' columns; standard uncertainties u(rho) = 6e-5 g/cm3, u(n_D) = 1.5e-4, u(T) = 0.01 K (rho) and 0.05 K (n_D) from the table footnotes; GC purity > 99.9 wt%, water 41 ppm
oh2018_table1_emc_density_nd.note: Single temperature only, so this is no n_D(T) source for issue 3. The Ref. columns are empty for EMC (no literature comparison value). The pure-EMC end of Table 4 (p. 142) was not read. Second reading 2026-11-28 by an independent pass over the extracted text: numbers and pages agree.

kozlova2008_table1_dmc_dhvap.quantity: enthalpy of vaporization of DMC at 298.15 K from transpiration vapour pressures, 274.2 to 304.1 K (EMC is not measured in this paper)
kozlova2008_table1_dmc_dhvap.source: S. A. Kozlova, V. N. Emel'yanenko, M. Georgieva, S. P. Verevkin, Y. Chernyak, B. Schaeffner, A. Boerner, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 40, 1136 (2008)
kozlova2008_table1_dmc_dhvap.location: Table 1 (DMC block header, 'This work' row in Table 2); the DEC value of the same paper is 44.35 +/- 0.22 kJ/mol
kozlova2008_table1_dmc_dhvap.note: DMC reference point for the SC-7 check of the Goldberg route (DMC from Goldberg Antoine minus this value). Not an EMC value. Page numbers of the tables not recorded. Second reading 2026-11-28 by an independent pass over the extracted text: numbers and pages agree.

zhang2010_table1_emc_boiling_point.quantity: boiling point T_b of EMC (Table 1, 'Tb/K') and measured boiling temperature of pure EMC at 101.3 kPa (Table 3), plus the Antoine constants quoted from ref. 7 of the paper, a 2008 master's thesis by Y. Jiaquan, National Central University, Taiwan (Table 2, log10(p/kPa) = A - B/(T/K + C))
zhang2010_table1_emc_boiling_point.source: X. Zhang, J. Zuo, C. Jian, J. Chem. Eng. Data 55, 4896 (2010)
zhang2010_table1_emc_boiling_point.location: Tables 1, 2 and 3 (p. 4896); EMC mass fraction 0.999 (Hebei Chaoyang Chemical Co.), GLC without observable impurities
zhang2010_table1_emc_boiling_point.note: The Antoine constants are not from this work (cited correlation, ref. 7), so they are not an independent EMC vapour-pressure measurement. Their valid range (317.56 K and above) excludes 298.15 K. Second reading 2026-11-28 by an independent pass over the extracted text: numbers and pages agree.
